comment: The retention clock for the local agent data store. The standard behind these numbers is docs/data-retention.md; the mechanism that enforces them is tools/agent-retention/. Changing a retentionDays value here changes what is deleted on the next sweep — it is a Legal & Privacy decision, not a config tidy-up.

acpSessions.comment: ACP session state is never eligible for retention deletion. Only acpx.session_options.env values are redacted.
